# Julia Scripts Module

*This file was generated by **gpt-oss-120b***

## Purpose

The **`julia_scripts`** directory contains a collection of Julia scripts that are used throughout the XBeach processing workflow. These scripts provide utilities for data extraction, statistical analysis, and other helper functionality that complement the Python‑based processing pipeline.

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `Manifest.toml` | Records the exact versions of all Julia package dependencies used by the scripts. |
| `Project.toml` | Defines the Julia project environment, including package requirements and compatibility information. |
| `get_output_stats.jl` | A Julia script that reads XBeach output files and computes summary statistics (e.g., wave heights, run‑up, inundation metrics). |

## Usage Example
```julia
# Activate the project environment
using Pkg
Pkg.activate("@__DIR__")

# Run the statistics script
include("get_output_stats.jl")
```

The scripts can be executed directly from the command line with `julia get_output_stats.jl` after activating the environment, or they can be imported into other Julia codebases as needed.
